Affinity: Each permanent you control of the stated kind reduces this spell's cost by {1}.
Amplify: As this creature enters, reveal any number of creature cards from your hand sharing a creature type with it. Each revealed card adds N +1/+1 counters, where N is the amplify value.
Assist: Another player may help pay the generic mana in this spell's cost.
Bands with other: Creatures meeting the stated banding conditions can attack together in a band and use the special banding damage-assignment rules.
Champion: When this enters, sacrifice it unless you exile another permanent you control of the specified kind. When this leaves, return that exiled card to the battlefield.
Craft: At sorcery speed, pay the craft cost and exile this permanent and the required materials to return this card transformed.
Devour: As this enters, you may sacrifice qualifying permanents. Each one gives it a number of +1/+1 counters equal to its devour value.
Emerge: Sacrifice a qualifying permanent and pay the emerge cost, reducing its generic mana by the sacrificed permanent's mana value.
Enchant: Specifies what this Aura can legally target and remain attached to.
Equip: Pay the equip cost at sorcery speed to attach this Equipment to a qualifying target creature you control.
Firebending: Whenever this creature attacks, add red mana equal to its firebending value. That mana lasts until the end of combat.
Gift: You may promise an opponent the listed gift as you cast this spell. Its card type determines when the gift is delivered; the card describes your additional benefit.
Landwalk: This creature cannot be blocked if the defending player controls a land of the specified kind.
Ninjutsu: Pay the cost and return an unblocked attacker you control to hand to put this card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking the same opponent, planeswalker or battle. Commander ninjutsu can also be used from the command zone.
Offering: Sacrifice a permanent of the required kind to cast this spell at instant timing, reducing its cost by that permanent's mana cost, including colored components.
Partner with: When this enters, target player may search for the named partner, put it into their hand, then shuffle. The specified pair may be your two commanders.
Splice: While casting a spell of the stated kind, reveal this card from your hand and pay its splice cost to add its rules text to that spell. This card stays in your hand.
TypeCycling: Pay the cost and discard this card to search your library for a card of the specified type, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. This does not draw a card.
Companion: If your starting deck meets the restriction, reveal this companion from outside the game. Once per game, pay {3} at sorcery speed to put it into your hand.
Mayhem: If you discarded this card this turn, you may cast it from your graveyard for its mayhem cost, following normal timing. Mayhem without a cost allows you to play the card from your graveyard that turn.
Haunt: Exile this card from the graveyard haunting a target creature when its haunt ability resolves. Its other ability triggers when the haunted creature dies.
Paradigm: The first time a spell you control with this name resolves this game, it sets up a free copy at the beginning of each later precombat main phase. Exile this spell.
Read ahead: Choose this Saga's starting chapter as it enters. During that turn, skipped chapters do not trigger.
Delve: While paying for this spell, each card you exile from your graveyard can pay for {1} of its generic mana cost.
Convoke: While paying for this spell, each creature you tap can pay for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.
